options.name: addr_gen_mode6
options.description: Configure method for creating the address for use with IPv6 Stateless Address Autoconfiguration. V(default) and V(default-or-eui64) have been added in community.general 6.5.0.

options.name: ageingtime
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [ageing-time <0-1000000>] the Ethernet MAC address aging time, in seconds.

options.name: arp_interval
options.description: This is only used with bond - ARP interval.

options.name: arp_ip_target
options.description: This is only used with bond - ARP IP target.

options.name: autoconnect
options.description: Whether the connection should start on boot. Whether the connection profile can be automatically activated.

options.name: autoconnect_priority
options.description: The priority of the connection profile for autoconnect. If set, connection profiles with higher priority are preferred.

options.name: autoconnect_retries
options.description: The number of times to retry autoconnecting.

options.name: conn_name
options.description: The name used to call the connection. Pattern is V(<type>[-<ifname>][-<num>]).

options.name: conn_reload
options.description: Whether the connection should be reloaded if it was modified.

options.name: dhcp_client_id
options.description: DHCP Client Identifier sent to the DHCP server.

options.name: dns4
options.description: A list of up to 3 DNS servers. The entries must be IPv4 addresses, for example V(192.0.2.53).

options.name: dns4_ignore_auto
options.description: Ignore automatically configured IPv4 name servers.

options.name: dns4_options
options.description: A list of DNS options.

options.name: dns4_search
options.description: A list of DNS search domains.

options.name: dns6
options.description: A list of up to 3 DNS servers. The entries must be IPv6 addresses, for example V(2001:4860:4860::8888).

options.name: dns6_ignore_auto
options.description: Ignore automatically configured IPv6 name servers.

options.name: dns6_options
options.description: A list of DNS options.

options.name: dns6_search
options.description: A list of DNS search domains.

options.name: downdelay
options.description: This is only used with bond - downdelay.

options.name: egress
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - VLAN egress priority mapping.

options.name: fail_over_mac
options.description: This is only used with bond - fail_over_mac.

options.name: flags
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - flags.

options.name: forwarddelay
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [forward-delay <2-30>] STP forwarding delay, in seconds.

options.name: gsm
options.description: The configuration of the GSM connection. Note the list of suboption attributes may vary depending on which version of NetworkManager/nmcli is installed on the host. An up-to-date list of supported attributes can be found here: U(https://networkmanager.dev/docs/api/latest/settings-gsm.html). For instance to use apn, pin, username and password: V({apn: provider.apn, pin: 1234, username: apn.username, password: apn.password}).

options.name: gw4
options.description: The IPv4 gateway for this interface. Use the format V(192.0.2.1). This parameter is mutually_exclusive with never_default4 parameter.

options.name: gw4_ignore_auto
options.description: Ignore automatically configured IPv4 routes.

options.name: gw6
options.description: The IPv6 gateway for this interface. Use the format V(2001:db8::1).

options.name: gw6_ignore_auto
options.description: Ignore automatically configured IPv6 routes.

options.name: hairpin
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge-slave' - 'hairpin mode' for the slave, which allows frames to be sent back out through the slave the frame was received on. The default change to V(false) in community.general 7.0.0. It used to be V(true) before.

options.name: hellotime
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [hello-time <1-10>] STP hello time, in seconds.

options.name: ifname
options.description: The interface to bind the connection to. The connection is only applicable to this interface name. A special value of V(*) can be used for interface-independent connections. The O(ifname) argument is mandatory for all connection types except bond, team, bridge, vlan and vpn. This parameter defaults to O(conn_name) when left unset for all connection types except vpn that removes it.

options.name: ignore_unsupported_suboptions
options.description: Ignore suboptions which are invalid or unsupported by the version of NetworkManager/nmcli installed on the host. Only O(wifi) and O(wifi_sec) options are currently affected.

options.name: infiniband_mac
options.description: MAC address of the Infiniband IPoIB devices.

options.name: ingress
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - VLAN ingress priority mapping.

options.name: ip4
options.description: List of IPv4 addresses to this interface. Use the format V(192.0.2.24/24) or V(192.0.2.24). If defined and O(method4) is not specified, automatically set C(ipv4.method) to V(manual).

options.name: ip6
options.description: List of IPv6 addresses to this interface. Use the format V(abbe::cafe/128) or V(abbe::cafe). If defined and O(method6) is not specified, automatically set C(ipv6.method) to V(manual).

options.name: ip_privacy6
options.description: If enabled, it makes the kernel generate a temporary IPv6 address in addition to the public one.

options.name: ip_tunnel_dev
options.description: This is used with GRE/IPIP/SIT - parent device this GRE/IPIP/SIT tunnel, can use ifname.

options.name: ip_tunnel_input_key
options.description: The key used for tunnel input packets. Only used when O(type=gre).

options.name: ip_tunnel_local
options.description: This is used with GRE/IPIP/SIT - GRE/IPIP/SIT local IP address.

options.name: ip_tunnel_output_key
options.description: The key used for tunnel output packets. Only used when O(type=gre).

options.name: ip_tunnel_remote
options.description: This is used with GRE/IPIP/SIT - GRE/IPIP/SIT destination IP address.

options.name: mac
options.description: MAC address of the connection. Note this requires a recent kernel feature, originally introduced in 3.15 upstream kernel.

options.name: macvlan
options.description: The configuration of the MAC VLAN connection. Note the list of suboption attributes may vary depending on which version of NetworkManager/nmcli is installed on the host. An up-to-date list of supported attributes can be found here: U(https://networkmanager.dev/docs/api/latest/settings-macvlan.html).

options.name: master
options.description: Master <master (ifname, or connection UUID or conn_name) of bridge, team, bond, ovs-port master connection profile. Mandatory if O(slave_type) is defined.

options.name: maxage
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [max-age <6-42>] STP maximum message age, in seconds.

options.name: may_fail4
options.description: If you need O(ip4) configured before C(network-online.target) is reached, set this option to V(false). This option applies when O(method4) is not V(disabled).

options.name: method4
options.description: Configuration method to be used for IPv4. If O(ip4) is set, C(ipv4.method) is automatically set to V(manual) and this parameter is not needed.

options.name: method6
options.description: Configuration method to be used for IPv6. If O(ip6) is set, C(ipv6.method) is automatically set to V(manual) and this parameter is not needed. V(disabled) was added in community.general 3.3.0.

options.name: miimon
options.description: This is only used with bond - miimon. This parameter defaults to V(100) when unset.

options.name: mode
options.description: This is the type of device or network connection that you wish to create for a bond or bridge.

options.name: mtu
options.description: The connection MTU, for example V(9000). This can not be applied when creating the interface and is done once the interface has been created. Can be used when modifying Team, VLAN, Ethernet (Future plans to implement wifi, gsm, pppoe, infiniband). This parameter defaults to V(1500) when unset.

options.name: never_default4
options.description: Set as default route. This parameter is mutually_exclusive with gw4 parameter.

options.name: path_cost
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge-slave' - [<1-65535>] - STP port cost for destinations using this slave.

options.name: primary
options.description: This is only used with bond and is the primary interface name (for "active-backup" mode), this is the usually the 'ifname'.

options.name: priority
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge' - sets STP priority.

options.name: route_metric4
options.description: Set metric level of ipv4 routes configured on interface.

options.name: route_metric6
options.description: Set metric level of IPv6 routes configured on interface.

options.name: routes4
options.description: The list of IPv4 routes. Use the format V(192.0.3.0/24 192.0.2.1). To specify more complex routes, use the O(routes4_extended) option.

options.name: routes4_extended
options.description: The list of IPv4 routes.

options.name: routes6
options.description: The list of IPv6 routes. Use the format V(fd12:3456:789a:1::/64 2001:dead:beef::1). To specify more complex routes, use the O(routes6_extended) option.

options.name: routes6_extended
options.description: The list of IPv6 routes but with parameters.

options.name: routing_rules4
options.description: Is the same as in an C(ip rule add) command, except always requires specifying a priority.

options.name: routing_rules6
options.description: Is the same as in an C(ip rule add) command, except always requires specifying a priority.

options.name: runner
options.description: This is the type of device or network connection that you wish to create for a team.

options.name: runner_fast_rate
options.description: Option specifies the rate at which our link partner is asked to transmit LACPDU packets. If this is V(true) then packets are sent once per second. Otherwise they are sent every 30 seconds. Only allowed for O(runner=lacp).

options.name: runner_hwaddr_policy
options.description: This defines the policy of how hardware addresses of team device and port devices should be set during the team lifetime.

options.name: slave_type
options.description: Type of the device of this slave's master connection (for example V(bond)). Type V(ovs-port) is added in community.general 8.6.0.

options.name: slavepriority
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge-slave' - [<0-63>] - STP priority of this slave.

options.name: sriov
options.description: Allow to configure SR-IOV settings. An up-to-date list of supported attributes can be found here: U(https://networkmanager.pages.freedesktop.org/NetworkManager/NetworkManager/settings-sriov.html).

options.name: ssid
options.description: Name of the Wireless router or the access point.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the device should exist or not, taking action if the state is different from what is stated. Using O(state=present) creates connection set to be brought up automatically. Using O(state=up) and O(state=down) does not modify connection with other parameters. These states have been added in community.general 9.5.0.

options.name: stp
options.description: This is only used with bridge and controls whether Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is enabled for this bridge.

options.name: table
options.description: This is only used with VRF - VRF table number.

options.name: transport_mode
options.description: This option sets the connection type of Infiniband IPoIB devices.

options.name: type
options.description: This is the type of device or network connection that you wish to create or modify. Type V(dummy) is added in community.general 3.5.0. Type V(gsm) is added in community.general 3.7.0. Type V(infiniband) is added in community.general 2.0.0. Type V(loopback) is added in community.general 8.1.0. Type V(macvlan) is added in community.general 6.6.0. Type V(ovs-bridge) is added in community.general 8.6.0. Type V(ovs-interface) is added in community.general 8.6.0. Type V(ovs-port) is added in community

options.name: updelay
options.description: This is only used with bond - updelay.

options.name: vlandev
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - parent device this VLAN is on, can use ifname.

options.name: vlanid
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - VLAN ID in range <0-4095>.

options.name: vpn
options.description: Configuration of a VPN connection (PPTP and L2TP). In order to use L2TP you need to be sure that C(network-manager-l2tp) - and C(network-manager-l2tp-gnome) if host has UI - are installed on the host.

options.name: vxlan_id
options.description: This is only used with VXLAN - VXLAN ID.

options.name: vxlan_local
options.description: This is only used with VXLAN - VXLAN local IP address.

options.name: vxlan_parent
options.description: This is only used with VXLAN - VXLAN parent device (required when using a multicast remote address).

options.name: vxlan_remote
options.description: This is only used with VXLAN - VXLAN destination IP address.

options.name: wifi
options.description: The configuration of the WiFi connection. Note the list of suboption attributes may vary depending on which version of NetworkManager/nmcli is installed on the host. An up-to-date list of supported attributes can be found here: U(https://networkmanager.dev/docs/api/latest/settings-802-11-wireless.html). For instance to create a hidden AP mode WiFi connection: V({hidden: true, mode: ap}).

options.name: wifi_sec
options.description: The security configuration of the WiFi connection. Note the list of suboption attributes may vary depending on which version of NetworkManager/nmcli is installed on the host. An up-to-date list of supported attributes can be found here: U(https://networkmanager.dev/docs/api/latest/settings-802-11-wireless-security.html). For instance to use common WPA-PSK auth with a password: V({key-mgmt: wpa-psk, psk: my_password}).

options.name: wireguard
options.description: The configuration of the Wireguard connection. Note the list of suboption attributes may vary depending on which version of NetworkManager/nmcli is installed on the host. An up-to-date list of supported attributes can be found here: U(https://networkmanager.dev/docs/api/latest/settings-wireguard.html). For instance to configure a listen port: V({listen-port: 12345}).

options.name: xmit_hash_policy
options.description: This is only used with bond - xmit_hash_policy type.

options.name: zone
options.description: The trust level of the connection. When updating this property on a currently activated connection, the change takes effect immediately.
